capture.zh: 哈莫星龙王圣殿（早期随剧情出现在塔克星、斯科尔星）随时可挑战；打败获得哈莫雷特精元（孵化得哈莫）和成就。

strategy_notes.zh: 准备水、火、草三系精灵按「水→火→草」轮流出手（每打一下换一只），其他属性打它不掉血。可用融合获得的丽莎布布学习花草护体提高双防，配合体力和 PP 药剂耗光攻击技能的 PP，再轮换输出；受到致命一击后留意对应防御强化并重新补强。

engine_notes: damage_only_from types water/fire/grass: other skill types deal 0.

type_rotation (stricter than no_repeat_type): a damaging hit only counts if its skill type is the next one in the cycle 水→火→草→水…; an out-of-order hit deals 0 (techbang 2011: 如果顺序错误的话，BOSS就不会损血). 7k7k phrases it as 每种属性只能打一次 (per cycle). Rotation is by skill type here; several guides phrase it by monster type (先上水系，然后上火系…) because each pet used its own STAB move.
Immune to 麻痹、寄生种子、中毒 and 海洋之心 (percent damage).
no_struggle: the classic plan was to drain its attack PP (龙王波/龙爪闪空破/龙王灭碎阵) and then rotate safely.
HP conflict: 7k7k 2011 says 3000; 4399 (2010-06-01) and weste (2010-09) say 10000. 10000 used (two 2010 sources, and the 10-20 minute fights).
龙之意志 (20269) raises its atk/def/spa by 1; clearing boosts first was standard.
skills: all four are named by period guides (4399 2010-06-01, 7k7k 2011-03-16) and equal species 216's last four at or below Lv80 (龙王灭碎阵 at Lv80 is included).
reward: 精元 item (kind essence) hatching the base form of the line at Lv1, as the original 分子转化器 did (e.g. 里奥斯精元 → 胡里亚, 阿克希亚精元 → 索拉, 斯普林特精元 → 斯林德).
寄生种子、镇魂歌、海洋之心、同生共死 and 极度冰点 have no effect; 极度冰点 does nothing even when it hits (T客邦 2011-01-20, 4399 2010-07).
source_note: 4399 2010-06-01: 80级 10000血, 必须水火草轮流; 7k7k 2011: 仅受水火草属性招式有效，每种属性限打一次; techbang 2011-01: 顺序错误不损血, 免疫麻痹/寄生/中毒/海洋之心.
